metrics.invalid_reason: Pre-registered exact portfolio path identity versus 001 failed. Re-executing the unchanged engine produced floating-point path drift: candidate max relative difference about 1.33e-15 and control about 1.0e-15. Although economically negligible, the frozen exact-identity gate is binary and cannot be relaxed after formal execution. Corrected performance metrics emitted by this run are not used.

decision: INVALID_PATH_IDENTITY. This trial was allowed to change metrics only and required exact candidate/control portfolio path equality to predecessor 001. Re-executing the same engine introduced machine-level floating-point drift, so the exact gate failed even though the maximum relative difference is about 1e-15. No corrected performance metric from 002 is accepted or inspected. The next allowed repair is measurement-only computation directly from the immutable 001 portfolio CSVs, with no strategy re-execution.
